action: List pptx structure and embedded objects: $ ls -l /root/input.pptx && mkdir -p /root/work && python -c "import sys"
Find OOXML unpack/pack scripts for pptx editing: $ which python3 && find /root -maxdepth 4 -name unpack.py -o -name pack.py -o -name validate.py | head
Search for ooxml pptx editing scripts under /root: $ find /root -maxdepth 10 -path '*/ooxml/scripts/*' -type f -name '*.py' | head -n 50
List pptx contents to find embedded Excel objects: $ rm -rf /root/work && mkdir -p /root/work/unz && unzip -l /root/input.pptx | sed -n '1,200p'
Install unzip utility for extracting pptx zip contents: $ apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y unzip zip

List pptx zip entries using Python zipfile: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile p='/root/input.pptx' with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:     names=z.namelist() print('entries',len(names)) for n in names:     if 'embeddings' in n or n.endswith('.xml') and 'slides/' in n:         pass for n in names:     if 'ppt/embeddings' in n or 'ppt/oleObjects' in n:         print(n) PY

Extract embedded Excel workbook from PPTX to workspace: $ mkdir -p /root/work && python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile, os pptx='/root/input.pptx' out='/root/work/embedded.xlsx' with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx) as z:     data=z.read('ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx') open(out,'wb').write(data) print('wrote',out,'bytes',len(data)) PY
Check if openpyxl installed in python3 environment: $ python3 - <<'PY' import importlib.util print('openpyxl', bool(importlib.util.find_spec('openpyxl'))) PY

Find which slide references the embedded Excel workbook: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile, re pptx='/root/input.pptx' needle='ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx' with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx) as z:     rels=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('ppt/slides/_rels/') and n.endswith('.rels')]     hits=[]     for r in rels:         xml=z.read(r).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')         if needle in xml:             hits.append(r)     print('rels hits:', hits) PY

Search slide rels for embeddings workbook relative target: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile pptx='/root/input.pptx' needle='embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx' with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx) as z:     rels=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('ppt/slides/_rels/') and n.endswith('.rels')]     hits=[]     for r in rels:         xml=z.read(r).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')         if needle in xml:             hits.append(r)     print('hits',hits) PY

Read embedded Excel sheet values and formulas to locate rate table: $ python3 - <<'PY' from openpyxl import load_workbook wb=load_workbook('/root/work/embedded.xlsx', data_only=False) print('sheets', wb.sheetnames) ws=wb[wb.sheetnames[0]] # determine used range max_row=ws.max_row max_col=ws.max_column print('max',max_row,max_col) # print small grid def cell_repr(c):     v=c.value     if v is None: return ''     if isinstance(v,str) and v.startswith('='): return v     return str(v) for r in range(1, min(max_row,20)+1):     row=[]     for c in range(1, min(max_col,20)+1):         row.append(cell_repr(ws.cell(r,c)))     if any(x!='' for x in row):         print(r, '\t'.join(row)) PY

Extract all text strings from slide1 to find updated rate: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET pptx='/root/input.pptx' slide='ppt/slides/slide1.xml' ns={  'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',  'p':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main' } with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx) as z:     xml=z.read(slide) root=ET.fromstring(xml) texts=[t.text for t in root.findall('.//a:t',ns) if t.text] print('texts found:',len(texts)) for t in texts:     print('-',t) PY

List pptx media entries to see embedded preview images: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile with zipfile.ZipFile('/root/input.pptx') as z:     for n in z.namelist():         if n.startswith('ppt/media/'):             print(n) PY

Inspect slide1.xml for OLE object and preview image references: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile pptx='/root/input.pptx' with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx) as z:     xml=z.read('ppt/slides/slide1.xml').decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') print(xml) PY

Parse updated rate, update embedded xlsx, and write results.pptx: $ python3 - <<'PY' import re, zipfile, io import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET from openpyxl import load_workbook  pptx_in='/root/input.pptx' pptx_out='/root/results.pptx' embed_path='ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx' slide_path='ppt/slides/slide1.xml'  ns={  'a':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',  'p':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main', }  with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_in) as zin:     slide_xml=zin.read(slide_path)     root=ET.fromstring(slide_xml)     texts=[t.text for t in root.findall('.//a:t',ns) if t.text]     slide_text='\n'.join(texts)  m=re.search(r'\b([A-Z]{3})\s*(?:to|→)\s*([A-Z]{3})\s*=\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\b', slide_text) if not m:     raise SystemExit(f'Could not parse updated rate from slide text: {slide_text!r}') from_ccy, to_ccy, rate_s = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3) rate=float(rate_s) print('parsed update:', from_ccy, '->', to_ccy, rate)  with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_in) as zin:     embedded=zin.read(embed_path)  wb=load_workbook(io.BytesIO(embedded), data_only=False) ws=wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]  # Build header maps (assume row1 has column currencies, col1 has row currencies) col_map={}  # currency -> column index for c in range(2, ws.max_column+1):     v=ws.cell(1,c).value     if isinstance(v,str) and v.strip():         col_map[v.strip().upper()]=c row_map={}  # currency -> row index for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):     v=ws.cell(r,1).value     if isinstance(v,str) and v.strip():         row_map[v.strip().upper()]=r  if from_ccy not in row_map or to_ccy not in col_map:     raise SystemExit(f'Currency not found in table. rows={sorted(row_map)} cols={sorted(col_map)}')  r=row_map[from_ccy] c=col_map[to_ccy] target=ws.cell(r,c)  if isinstance(target.value,str) and target.value.startswith('='):     # Try inverse cell     inv_r=row_map.get(to_ccy)     inv_c=col_map.get(from_ccy)     if inv_r is None or inv_c is None:         raise SystemExit(f'Target cell {from_ccy}->{to_ccy} is formula, and inverse missing')     inv=ws.cell(inv_r, inv_c)     if isinstance(inv.value,str) and inv.value.startswith('='):         raise SystemExit(f'Both target and inverse are formulas; refusing to hardcode over formulas')     inv_val=1.0/rate     print(f'target cell is formula; updating inverse {to_ccy}->{from_ccy} to {inv_val}')     inv.value=inv_val else:     print(f'updating {from_ccy}->{to_ccy} at {target.coordinate}: {target.value} -> {rate}')     target.value=rate  out_buf=io.BytesIO() wb.save(out_buf) new_embedded=out_buf.getvalue()  # Write new pptx with only embedding replaced with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_in) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_out,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:     for item in zin.infolist():         data=zin.read(item.filename)         if item.filename==embed_path:             data=new_embedded         zi=zipfile.ZipInfo(item.filename)         zi.date_time=item.date_time         zi.external_attr=item.external_attr         zi.internal_attr=item.internal_attr         zi.comment=item.comment         zi.extra=item.extra         zi.create_system=item.create_system         zout.writestr(zi, data)  print('wrote', pptx_out)  # Verify update by re-extracting embedded and reading updated cell with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_out) as z:     emb2=z.read(embed_path) wb2=load_workbook(io.BytesIO(emb2), data_only=False) ws2=wb2[wb2.sheetnames[0]] val=ws2.cell(row_map[from_ccy], col_map[to_ccy]).value print('verified cell', from_ccy,'->',to_ccy,'=',val) PY

Verify formula cells remain formulas in embedded workbook: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile, io from openpyxl import load_workbook pptx='/root/results.pptx' with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx) as z:     emb=z.read('ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx') wb=load_workbook(io.BytesIO(emb), data_only=False) ws=wb[wb.sheetnames[0]] checks=['C2','D2','E2','D3','E3','E4'] for addr in checks:     v=ws[addr].value     print(addr, v) PY

Confirm results.pptx exists and compare size with input: $ ls -l /root/input.pptx /root/results.pptx && python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile for p in ['/root/input.pptx','/root/results.pptx']:     with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:         print(p,'entries',len(z.namelist())) PY

Inspect original zip member compression types and sizes: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile from collections import Counter with zipfile.ZipFile('/root/input.pptx') as z:     c=Counter(i.compress_type for i in z.infolist())     print('compress types',c)     # print a few entries details     for i in z.infolist()[:10]:         print(i.filename, 'ctype', i.compress_type, 'csize', i.compress_size, 'usize', i.file_size) PY

Inspect results zip compression types to compare with input: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile from collections import Counter with zipfile.ZipFile('/root/results.pptx') as z:     c=Counter(i.compress_type for i in z.infolist())     print('compress types',c)     for i in z.infolist()[:10]:         print(i.filename, 'ctype', i.compress_type, 'csize', i.compress_size, 'usize', i.file_size) PY

Rewrite results.pptx preserving original zip compression methods: $ python3 - <<'PY' import zipfile, io pptx_in='/root/input.pptx' pptx_out='/root/results.pptx' embed_path='ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx'  # Load updated embedded workbook from current results (already updated) with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_out) as z:     updated_emb=z.read(embed_path)  with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_in) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_out+'.tmp','w') as zout:     for item in zin.infolist():         data = zin.read(item.filename)         if item.filename == embed_path:             data = updated_emb         zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(item.filename)         zi.date_time = item.date_time         zi.compress_type = item.compress_type         zi.comment = item.comment         zi.extra = item.extra         zi.create_system = item.create_system         zi.create_version = item.create_version         zi.extract_version = item.extract_version         zi.flag_bits = item.flag_bits         zi.volume = item.volume         zi.internal_attr = item.internal_attr         zi.external_attr = item.external_attr         # writestr will use zi.compress_type         zout.writestr(zi, data)  # atomic replace import os os.replace(pptx_out+'.tmp', pptx_out)  # quick verify compression mix from collections import Counter with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx_out) as z:     print('compression:', Counter(i.compress_type for i in z.infolist())) PY ls -l /root/input.pptx /root/results.pptx
